COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.204.option_a: Close the unanswered Egyptian coordination proposal. No joint mission or payment is activated; the cabinet receives a report on the expired request.
COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.207.option_a: Close the unanswered notice of Syrian war aims. No negotiating consent, territorial settlement or change to the war is granted; the cabinet receives a report.
COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.208.option_a: Close the unanswered disengagement proposal. No agreement or change to the war is imposed; the cabinet receives a report.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.1.option_a: Confirm recovery of the Golan as the limited political objective. The chosen preparations remain available; an existing war goal is not renewed or duplicated, and war must still be declared through diplomacy.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.1.option_b: Record Syria's willingness to keep a negotiating channel open alongside its existing Golan preparations. This declaration grants no foreign consent, peace agreement or transfer of territory.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.2.option_a: Record the cabinet's request for an operational appropriation. Funding and authorization still require their separate decisions; submitting this brief spends no money and mobilizes no forces.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.2.option_b: Record a defensive staff brief. This choice grants no offensive mandate or operational package and does not refund earlier expenditure.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.3.option_a: Withhold the operational mandate. The existing appropriation retains its original expiry date; no preparations are authorized and the expenditure is not refunded.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.3.option_b: Authorize separately funded Golan preparations and end the defensive brief while the appropriation and objective remain valid. Reserve, supply, medical and operational-window packages still require their own decisions and spending.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.4.option_a: Decline the Syrian coordination proposal and notify Damascus. No Egyptian forces, money or planning mission are committed.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.4.option_b: Accept the proposed coordination terms and send them to Damascus for funding. Syria must still authorize the quarter-percent-of-GDP payment before a new mission begins; Egypt enters no war and transfers no troops.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.5.option_a: Cancel this accepted coordination offer. No new planning mission begins and no additional coordination payment is charged.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.5.option_b: Pay 0.25% of Syria's current GDP and establish the accepted Egyptian joint planning mission for 180 days. It improves maximum planning and organization while increasing bureaucracy expenditure; benefits and burdens end together if the operational mandate or Golan objective lapses.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.5.option_c: Recognize the existing Egyptian coalition arrangements and close this offer. Keep their existing effects without another charge or a duplicate Syrian planning bonus.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.6.option_a: Stand down this funded window before activation. No offensive or sustained-pressure modifiers are granted; the preparatory expenditure is not refunded.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.6.option_b: Commit the campaign's single operational window to a 60-day short offensive. Attack and maximum planning improve at the cost of higher supply consumption and personnel expenditure; all window effects end together on expiry or loss of the mandate or Golan objective.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.6.option_c: Commit the campaign's single operational window to 120 days of sustained pressure. Defence and organization improve while personnel expenditure rises and civilian factory output falls; all window effects end together on expiry or loss of the mandate or Golan objective.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.7.option_a: Record a willingness to negotiate and notify Damascus that a channel is open. No territorial concession or peace agreement is concluded by this reply.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.7.option_b: Reject the stated Syrian position and notify Damascus. This reply grants no negotiating consent and changes neither territory nor the war.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.8.option_a: Decline the proposed disengagement terms and notify Damascus. No consent, territorial settlement or change to the war is granted.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.8.option_b: Record Israel's consent to discuss disengagement and open a negotiating channel with Damascus. The actual governments and coalition war leaders must still negotiate any peace or territorial settlement through diplomacy.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.9.option_a: Acknowledge the diplomatic report. This notice grants no new payment, military bonus or territorial settlement; only arrangements that were actually accepted and funded remain in force.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.10.option_a: Complete the cabinet's campaign review while maintaining its stated limited objective. Existing operational commitments keep their own expiry dates; no temporary bonus is renewed.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.10.option_b: Complete the campaign review and record the cabinet's intention to seek disengagement. Existing commitments keep their expiry dates; a negotiated pause still requires the other governments' agreement.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.10.option_c: Complete the campaign review and convene the demobilization decision. The campaign establishment is removed only when demobilization is confirmed in that event.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.11.option_a: End any short-offensive or sustained-pressure package, removing both its advantages and spending burdens. Reserve, supply, joint-planning and medical commitments retain their own expiry dates.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.11.option_b: End both operational-window packages and convene a wider cabinet review. Other campaign commitments retain their own expiry dates until their separate termination or demobilization.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.12.option_a: End the operational mandate and appropriation authorization, removing reserve, supply, joint-planning, medical and window packages with their costs. Durable training, public debt and any unexpired emergency-credit premium remain; expenditure already incurred is not refunded.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.13.option_a: Decline the training request and notify Damascus. No Soviet assistance capacity, political power or recurring aid expenditure is committed, and Syria pays no hosting fee.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.13.option_b: Authorize one military training mission. Soviet commitment: 1 assistance-capacity slot and 25 Political Power, plus the agreed weekly assistance expenditure. Syria pays $0.060 billion in hosting costs when the mission starts.
COLDWAR_SYR_WAR.14.option_a: Review the governments’ training agreement and close the outstanding request.
COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.213.option_a: Close the expired training request and send it to the cabinet for review. No new mission or hosting payment is activated.
COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.40.option_a: Decline additional American sanctions. This event adds no new sanctions or Syrian penalties; any sanctions already in force remain governed by their existing terms.
COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.40.option_b: Political Power: −35. Impose American diplomatic sanctions on Syria.
COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.101.option_a: Close the unanswered development-credit offer. No Soviet funds are transferred and no Syrian debt is added.

COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.20.option_c: Ask Kuwait to fund one $0.200 billion civil project. Its government must consent and pay from its own treasury; this request alone provides Syria with neither cash nor a building.

COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.21.option_b: Commit $0.200 billion to the Syrian civil project. The grant finances one agreed construction project and can be returned to the donor if construction cannot proceed.

COLDWAR_SYR_FOREIGN.22.option_c: Complete 1 Infrastructure level in Latakia using the agreed grant. Requires Syrian ownership, control and building capacity.
